J&K school book controversy sparks debate over content

A book used in Jammu and Kashmir schools has become the center of a controversy, with a BJP leader demanding its ban for allegedly promoting a separatist narrative. A former Chief Minister stated he had never heard of the book. The book reportedly includes figures associated with terrorism and separatism as 'great personalities'.
